prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, grab it. Then move it and perform task. Else, approach, take and move object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesignatedArea    /> <Action ID = PerformObjectTask    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInCorrectArea    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInSight    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectInProximity    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectSafeToCarry    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDesignatedArea
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectInCorrectArea? THEN
			DO PerformObjectTask
	END
